summary_paragraph: Mr. Thompson was admitted for his ninth cycle of high-dose methotrexate since CNS lymphoma relapse, marking the fifth maintenance dose and second bimonthly administration. He tolerated the chemotherapy infusion well without complications. His candidal chest rash improved with topical miconazole, and he remained neurologically stable with no new deficits. Methotrexate levels were monitored and cleared appropriately. Liver enzymes rose transiently as expected. Aspirin and omeprazole were held during treatment and restarted at discharge. A brain MRI showed no new enhancing lesions, indicating stable disease. He was discharged home in stable condition with follow-up scheduled for the next cycle in two months.
